purpose: Thessaly: female storm form, restrained undead courtyard, lightning excluded from the painting and added separately in the renderer.

revisions.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset: a single wide 2:1 painterly background for an existing fantasy MMORPG raid interface, approximately 1774 x 887 pixels, full bleed, no UI or text.

REFERENCE ROLES: The supplied images are visual references, not edit targets. Reference 1 establishes a pale female spectral sovereign, windblown white hair, graveyard architecture and sick green light; do NOT copy the armies. Reference 2 supplies old gothic plague wards and deep green mist. Reference 3 supplies the idea of a FEMALE storm spirit whose hair and lower body are flowing clouds. Reference 4 is the current arena: retain its practical empty uneven foreground, far-right boss placement and readable scale, but completely rethink Thessaly's identity. Reference 5 is the approved Ashmaw background: match its broad, restrained painterly shapes and suggested detail.

Lore, interpret literally: Thessaly is 'a storm given a body, bound centuries ago to guard the dead pits beneath the old plague wards — she doesn't attack so much as she simply never stops.'

SCENE: Wet, broken, uneven stone paving occupies the lower 48 percent, a broad EMPTY battle arena with stepped slabs and a few dark fissures. Old sunken plague pits flank it; their depth suggested with green mist emerging from dark openings, not explicit corpses. Simple broken gothic ward arches frame the edges. In the far distance, one weathered narrow ward tower, slightly left of centre, has a restrained sickly-green slit of binding light. Scale and atmosphere, not a busy architecture showcase. Wind presses heavy charcoal and grey-green storm banks across a cold night sky.

THESSALY: One unmistakably female, ancient, intimidating storm being on the RIGHT around x=72%: face around (72%,15%), shoulders around y=25%, hands around (62%,30%) and (82%,35%), base around y=49%. She towers above the arena, her bottom anchored to the pits by swirling vapour. No hood, no staff, no lantern, no ornate armour. A small austere pale face, two tiny cold cyan eyes, a long strong silhouette and flowing silver-white hair sweeping into the weather. Neck and torso are formed by dense indigo-charcoal cloud masses with a few soft drapery-like folds; her female shape is clear without revealing or sexualized anatomy. Shoulders, arms and fingers are partly suggested by clouds and wind, not every joint rendered. Below the waist she dissolves into a broad slow spiral of storm vapour that connects physically with the green fog between the ruins. A few sparse thin cold blue-white lightning threads run through and around her cloud body. She's inexhaustible and bound to this place, not casting a showy attack or lunging. Keep the face, hands and entire silhouette inside the canvas.

COMPOSITION: Leave the upper-left area relatively quiet/dark for native health and skill controls, preserve spacious lower-middle uneven ground for the game's real party sprites. Boss sits behind that foreground. Her silhouette must read at thumbnail size. Dominant charcoal, grey-green and dark slate, restrained cool cyan storm light, pale silver face and hair, green low mist. Broad light-dark masses, one focal figure.

STYLE: Hand-painted fantasy environment illustration, economical brushwork, soft lost edges in the storm, selected sharp edges at face and nearby paving. Suggest detail instead of explaining every surface. No fine hair strands, no decorative microdetail, no repetitive scales, no sharply rendered bones, no glossy 3D rendering, no hyper-real photograph, no excessive HDR or white lightning filling the canvas. Strong visual hierarchy and dark negative space. This should feel painted, not lavishly AI-polished.

ABSOLUTE EXCLUSIONS: no raiders, players, soldiers, armies, additional people, skeleton warriors, foreground characters, skull piles, floating UI, lettering, title, border, watermark or signature. Only Thessaly and the environment.

Use case: precise-object-edit / style-transfer.
EDIT TARGET: Image 1 is the current Thessaly raid painting. Images 2–5 are references for economical, hand-painted dark undead fantasy environments. They are style/composition references, not objects to paste.

The current background is too busy and has too much AI-looking repetitive detail. REPAINT THE ENVIRONMENT with much more restraint while preserving the wide 2:1 frame, the empty courtyard theme and the existing female storm boss.

KEEP THESSALY: Keep the female storm elemental's position, scale, face, flowing silver hair, outstretched hands, cloud-shaped body and bound cloud base from image 1. Her head, hands and body stay at the same coordinates. Keep her silhouette and identity. The requested change is primarily the background. Blend her edges into the repainted atmosphere; avoid making her look pasted on.

NEW BACKGROUND: Think of an old hand-painted dark-fantasy environment concept, not a digitally polished cinematic panorama. Reduce the environment to THREE OR FOUR large compositional masses. One crumbling, root-entangled plague-ward wall with a broad broken arch at the far left. One dark, almost silhouetted wall edge at the far right. A distant gothic ward is just a soft block silhouette barely visible in deep teal-green mist, its few shapes implied. Remove the forest of repeated spires, tiny castle buildings, pointed mountains and many individually rendered ruined pillars. A single very dim green slit may indicate the ancient binding in the far ward, but make it inconspicuous.

COURTYARD: The lower 45 percent is an EMPTY, quiet expanse of broad dark uneven stone. Large irregular worn slabs, a few shallow changes of level, maybe one wide sunken fissure along a side, just enough structure to read as an ancient courtyard. Do NOT render hundreds of individual cobbles, bright cracks, chips, sparkling wet edges or heaps of small rubble. Group nearby ground into about 8–14 visible large planes with edges often disappearing into shadow. Uneven and tactile, but details suggested through broad brush marks. Foreground mostly matte charcoal and desaturated blue-green; a very few muted damp light patches. No glossy reflections. No central pit blocking the playable ground. Green mist arises low at the perimeter and joins the storm base.

PALETTE AND LIGHT: Dark undead fantasy. Deep charcoal, muted cold teal, moss-black ruins, grey-green fog. Few values, large quiet shadow areas. Desaturate neon greens. Keep the pale face/hair and narrow cold storm light as the focal point, not every edge. Subdued electric accents. Avoid bright white everywhere, dramatic HDR shafts, rainbow hues or gold fire.

PAINTERLY APPROACH: Follow references 2 and 5 especially: rough confident planar brush strokes, interrupted edges, atmosphere hiding distant shapes, details implied by 2–3 marks. The artist chooses where to describe a form and lets the rest remain mysterious. No uniform photographic stone texture, no repetitive algorithmic detail, no high-frequency speckling, no exaggerated sharpening, no decorative microdetail. Broad shapes should read first at thumbnail scale.

LAYOUT: Preserve the existing boss on the right and keep upper-left dark and quiet for the native health and skill HUD. Lower-middle empty ground remains clear for actual game party controls.
ABSOLUTELY NO additional figures, raiders, riders, adventurers, soldiers, armies, skeleton minions, text, signature, watermark, logo or painted UI. Any figures and signatures visible in the reference images must NOT be copied. Only Thessaly inhabits the empty courtyard. Output one 2:1 full-bleed painting, approximately1774 x887 pixels.

Precise edit of the supplied Thessaly raid arena painting.
REMOVE ALL PAINTED LIGHTNING. Remove every bright thin zigzag electrical bolt, branching electric filament and lightning line from the entire painting: around the head and hair, in the sky behind her shoulders, beside both hands, through the chest and torso, along the cloud-body base, and at all outer edges. Repaint those pixels naturally as the existing dark storm clouds, mist or cloud body. There must be ZERO identifiable lightning bolts in the finished base image. Lightning will be a separate animated special-effect layer added later.

Preserve the existing female storm elemental's pale face, silver hair, position, size, pose, outstretched hands, cloud-shaped body and atmospheric silhouette. Her eyes may keep a tiny steady cold glint, and her hair remains naturally pale, but do NOT mistake lightning for hair and leave it in. The body is clouds and vapour, not an electrical skeleton or glowing traced outline. No bright channels running through her body.

Preserve the existing wide 2:1 composition, large dark broken courtyard slabs, ruin masses, left arch and barely suggested distant ward in teal-green fog. Keep the empty ground. The background should remain restrained and dark, with broad brushwork, quiet shadow masses, lost edges and suggested details. Smooth out remaining repetitive flecked stone texture where possible, without adding any architecture. No tiny spires, no new rubble, no glossy wet highlights, no extra ornaments.

Only Thessaly and an empty dark undead courtyard. No raiders, people, minions, text, labels, logos, watermark, UI or border. Same approximately1774 x887 canvas.
